con Allinea alla guida e in modalità Shuffle e Ripple, dove i clip spinti o fatti scorrere si portano dietro la loro curva. Range: rimuovi (chiude il vuoto) toglie lo stesso tempo anche dalle curve delle tracce del range: prima e dopo il taglio restano com'erano. Con Range: elimina, che lascia il vuoto, le curve non cambiano.
en: and in Shuffle and Ripple mode, where clips that are pushed or slide along take their curve with them.

with Align to guide, and in Shuffle and Ripple mode, where clips that are pushed or slide along take their curve with them. Range: remove (close the gap) removes the same time from the curves of the tracks in the range too: before and after the cut they stay as they were. With Range: delete, which leaves the gap, the curves do not change.
